evals.prompt: 根据项目里的 md 文档初始化项目规则，帮我生成 AGENTS.md 文件。
evals.expected_output: 在工作区 .agents/AGENTS.md 中成功生成包含 prd.md 和 tech-stack.md 核心规则的结构化配置
expectations: The output includes a section for Business Logic & Constraints
The output includes the business constraint: single file size <= 50MB
The output includes the business constraint: sharing link <= 7 days
The output includes the tech stack rule: Next.js 14 and Supabase
The output includes code conventions: Prisma ORM and forbidding console.log

evals.prompt: 我想初始化项目规则，请根据项目中的文档自动生成 AGENTS.md。
evals.expected_output: 在 tech-stack.md 和 prd.md 缺失时，能够寻找到 README.md 并提取基本规则，同时向用户提示
expectations: The output includes standard memo rules like Vite and Raw CSS
The agent outputs a hint or message indicating that prd.md and tech-stack.md were missing

evals.prompt: 我们的 PRD 最近进行了修改，请帮我重新生成并更新 .agents/AGENTS.md 文件以同步最新规则。
evals.expected_output: 读取新的 prd.md 内容，并在现有的 .agents/AGENTS.md 中更新相关部分，同时保留原先技术栈相关的规则
expectations: The output contains the updated login method: WeChat Scan Login
The output contains WeChat Pay integration rules and webhook signature validation
The output retains Next.js 14, Supabase, and Prisma ORM rules
